answer:
The third largest river in the world by discharge is the **Orinoco River**, which primarily flows through **Venezuela and Colombia**.

Specifically:
- The river originates in Venezuela
- Approximately 65% of its course flows through Venezuela
- Approximately 35% of its course flows through Colombia (it forms part of the border between the two countries for much of its length)
- It empties into the Atlantic Ocean at the mouth known as Lake Maracaibo's eastern end in Venezuela
